profile.name: Huixuan Zhang
profile.bio: My current research focuses on multimodal generation, especially text-to-image diffusion models. I study inference-time alignment, controllable generation, and efficient guidance. I have also worked on multimodal evaluation, hallucination detection, benchmark contamination, and detection of AI-generated images.

interests: Multimodal generation, with a focus on text-to-image generation
Image–text alignment, including attribute and relation binding

news.text: Released Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO) as an arXiv preprint.
Minos and JointCQ appeared in Findings of ACL 2026.
How Much To Guide appeared at ACM Multimedia Asia 2025.

publications.title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
publications.description: Aligns text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions by optimizing the sampling trajectory at inference time, without backpropagating through the denoising network.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Qualitative comparison of four text-to-image alignment methods, including DTO

publications.title: Re-Thinking the Automatic Evaluation of Image-Text Alignment in Text-to-Image Models
publications.description: Tests whether automatic image–text alignment metrics are robust to small changes and whether their model rankings are statistically meaningful.
publications.thumbnailAlt: A visually imperceptible image change produces a substantial difference in VQAScore

publications.title: M³T2IBench: A Large-Scale Multi-Category, Multi-Instance, Multi-Relation Text-to-Image Benchmark
publications.description: Benchmarks prompts with multiple object categories, repeated instances, and relations, and introduces the detection-based AlignScore metric.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Overview of benchmark construction and AlignScore calculation

publications.title: KBE-DME: Dynamic Multimodal Evaluation via Knowledge Enhanced Benchmark Evolution
publications.description: Uses knowledge-based benchmark evolution to generate new evaluation items for multimodal models.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Graph formulation and knowledge-enhanced benchmark evolution framework

publications.title: DMC-CF: Dynamic Multimodal CounterFactual QA benchmark for Causal Reasoning
publications.description: Introduces a dynamic multimodal question-answering benchmark for assessing causal reasoning under counterfactual changes.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Static causal graph and dynamic graph intervention example

publications.title: MC-MKE: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Knowledge Editing Benchmark Emphasizing Modality Consistency
publications.description: Provides a fine-grained benchmark for testing whether multimodal knowledge edits stay consistent across modalities.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Multimodal knowledge editing data construction and selection

publications.title: Quantity Matters: Towards Assessing and Mitigating Number Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
publications.description: Evaluates object-count errors in large vision-language models and uses consistency training to reduce number hallucinations.
publications.thumbnailAlt: An example of incorrect object counting by a vision-language model

publications.title: C-FAITH: A Chinese Fine-Grained Benchmark for Automated Hallucination Evaluation
publications.description: Introduces a Chinese benchmark for fine-grained assessment of whether generated text stays faithful to its source.
publications.thumbnailAlt: HaluAgent framework for data generation, verification, and optimization

publications.title: Exploring Causal Effect of Social Bias on Faithfulness Hallucinations in Large Language Models
publications.description: Studies whether and how social bias affects the faithfulness of large language model outputs.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Experimental framework for assessing how social bias affects faithfulness

publications.title: PaCoST: Paired Confidence Significance Testing for Benchmark Contamination Detection in Large Language Models
publications.area: Data Contamination and Training Data Privacy
publications.description: Tests for benchmark contamination by comparing model confidence on original items with confidence on matched paraphrases.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Overview of paired confidence testing for benchmark contamination

publications.title: Tracing Training Footprints: A Calibration Approach for Membership Inference Attacks Against Multimodal Large Language Models
publications.area: Data Contamination and Training Data Privacy
publications.description: Studies calibrated membership inference for assessing training-data exposure in multimodal language models.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Overview of PC-MMIA calibration for multimodal membership inference

publications.title: UniAIDet: A Unified and Universal Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Content Detection and Localization
publications.description: Benchmarks detection and localization of AI-generated or edited regions across photographic and artistic images and diverse generators.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Overview of the UniAIDet benchmark and its image-generation tasks

publications.title: EAMA: Entity-Aware Multimodal Alignment Based Approach for News Image Captioning
publications.venue: ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications, and Applications
publications.description: Improves news image captioning by explicitly aligning entities in images and accompanying articles.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Entity-aware multimodal alignment and self-supplemented caption generation

publications.title: FactNLI: Dynamic and Automated Fact-Based Augmentation of NLI Benchmarks
publications.description: Augments natural language inference benchmarks with automatically generated examples grounded in facts.
publications.thumbnailAlt: FactNLI framework for retrieval, fact filtering, and example augmentation

publications.title: DecoCal: Decoding with Calibration in Diffusion Large Language Models
publications.description: Calibrates token confidence across denoising steps to improve decoding in diffusion language models.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Calibration, unmasking, and remasking in the DecoCal framework

publications.title: DAMON: A Dialogue-Aware MCTS Framework for Jailbreaking Large Language Models
publications.description: Studies the robustness of language-model safeguards in multi-turn dialogue.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Tree-search component of the DAMON framework

publications.title: How Much To Guide: Revisiting Adaptive Guidance in Classifier-Free Guidance Text-to-Vision Diffusion Models
publications.description: Introduces Step AG, which applies classifier-free guidance only during early denoising steps to reduce inference cost while preserving image quality and prompt alignment.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Generated examples comparing Step AG with standard classifier-free guidance

publications.title: R-Bind: Unified Enhancement of Attribute and Relation Binding in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
publications.description: An inference-time method for improving attribute and relation binding in text-to-image diffusion models.
publications.thumbnailAlt: R-Bind method overview showing attention-map optimization during denoising

publications.title: Minos: A Multimodal Evaluation Model for Bidirectional Generation Between Image and Text
publications.description: Develops a shared evaluator for text-to-image and image-to-text generation using quality-controlled training data and preference alignment.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Minos dataset construction pipeline for bidirectional generation evaluation

publications.title: Exploring and Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Reasoning Consistency of Multimodal Large Language Models
publications.description: Introduces four tasks and a dataset to measure whether multimodal models reach consistent reasoning outcomes across visual and textual inputs.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Examples of the four multimodal knowledge reasoning tasks

publications.title: JointCQ: Improving Factual Hallucination Detection with Joint Claim and Query Generation
publications.description: Extracts factual claims and generates search queries jointly to improve evidence retrieval and verification for generated text.
publications.thumbnailAlt: JointCQ training framework and factual hallucination detection pipeline

publications.title: ICR Probe: Tracking Hidden State Dynamics for Reliable Hallucination Detection in LLMs
publications.description: Detects hallucinations by tracking how model components update the residual stream across layers.
publications.thumbnailAlt: ICR Probe method for tracking hidden-state updates across layers

publications.title: Image Matters: A New Dataset and Empirical Study for Multimodal Hyperbole Detection
publications.description: A dataset and empirical study on identifying hyperbole using both text and images.
publications.thumbnailAlt: Attention-gate fusion architecture from Image Matters

publicationAreas: Data Contamination and Training Data Privacy
